verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's registered-agent page says customers receive legal documents electronically and are notified by phone when service of process arrives, so a lawsuit is not left waiting in a mail batch. The claim rests on a single first-party marketing line, which limits the depth of evidence. Missing for 10: a documented speed or turnaround commitment for the alert, coverage of time-sensitive notices other than service of process, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
